description: This file contains extension methods for DaemonSet listers in Kubernetes, providing functions to retrieve DaemonSets associated with Pods and ControllerRevisions.

classes.name: daemonSetLister
classes.description: A lister interface for DaemonSets, extended with custom methods to find DaemonSets related to Pods and ControllerRevisions.

methods.name: GetPodDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns a list of DaemonSets that potentially match a given Pod based on labels and namespace.

methods.name: GetHistoryDaemonSets
methods.description: Returns a list of DaemonSets that potentially match a given ControllerRevision based on labels and namespace.
